# STL Decomposition for a `ts_df`

Decomposes a complete seasonal `ts_df` with
[`stats::stl()`](https://rdrr.io/r/stats/stl.html).

## Usage

``` r
ts_stl(x, s_window = "periodic", robust = TRUE, ...)
```

## Arguments

- x:

  A complete seasonal `ts_df` with no missing values.

- s_window:

  Seasonal smoothing window.

- robust:

  Use robust STL fitting.

- ...:

  Additional arguments passed to
  [`stats::stl()`](https://rdrr.io/r/stats/stl.html).

## Value

A list with `components`, `strength`, and `model`.

## Examples

``` r
ts_stl(as_ts_df(AirPassengers))
```
